hero.description: Full-Stack Developer with 5+ years in PHP/Laravel, React, Vue.js and Next.js. I design solid backends, high-performance interfaces and high-availability deployments with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD on AWS. Try the terminal →

items.label: critical platforms on AWS and Kubernetes

about.titleHighlight: whoever maintains the code next in mind.
about.description: I'm a self-driven problem solver. I like to understand the business before writing a line, take care of the backend architecture and the interface experience, and leave clean code the team can maintain.

steps.title: I understand the business and design the solution
steps.text: I turn requirements into architecture: data model, Laravel services and the API contract before writing code.

steps.title: I build end to end
steps.text: Backends in PHP/Laravel or Node.js, interfaces in React, Vue.js or Next.js, and hybrid mobile apps with Ionic when the project needs it.

steps.title: I deploy with high availability
steps.text: Docker containers, Kubernetes ReplicaSets and CI/CD pipelines on AWS so critical platforms stay up.

steps.title: I work agile and with the team
steps.text: Scrum, technical leadership and clear communication, in English too with international stakeholders.

experience.title: Where I've worked
experience.subtitle: Four companies and 5+ years shipping products to production: from IT support to leading full-stack cloud projects.

items.description: I lead full-stack development for Grupo Coomeva: high-availability platforms on AWS and Kubernetes, a real-time 2026 World Cup prediction game with Laravel Reverb, the QuickPass hybrid app with Ionic 8 and a video game e-commerce with Next.js and Strapi.
Led the development of the company's internal CRM and built a product warranty module that automates communication and tracking with suppliers.
Lead developer on national and international B2B software projects, communicating requirements in English with stakeholders and supporting the company's POS software.
Level 2 on-site support at Banco Davivienda's headquarters and branches in Cali, resolving incidents for 200+ employees.

architecture.title: How I organize code
architecture.subtitle: Two patterns I apply in production: layered architecture to organize the backend, and continuous deployment to ship it with high availability.

patterns.title: Layered architecture
patterns.description: I keep business logic separate from the framework: each layer has a single responsibility, so the database or the API can change without rewriting the rules.

patterns.title: Deployment and high availability
patterns.description: Every change goes through an automated pipeline and reaches production in replicated containers, so critical platforms stay up even if a replica fails.
